facts.statement: SOE ran a Child's Play charity promotion in which select in-game items bought with Station Cash raised money for Child's Play, during December 21-31.
facts.quote: Por cada articulo seleccionado dentro del juego del 21 de Diciembre al 31 de Diciembre, SOE donara $10 a la beneficencia, hasta $50, 000 en total.

article_summaries.title: Child's Play 2010!
article_summaries.summary: A Spanish-language SOE news post (listed under Free Realms 'What is New?') announcing SOE's 2010 Child's Play charity promotion. Players could buy a special Free Realms penguin pet item with Station Cash between December 21 and December 31, and SOE would donate $10 per item sold, up to $50,000 total. The post's date is not shown in the text, only 'Posted 5 months, 2 weeks ago' relative to capture.
